messages.content: For this planning task, keep these fixed inputs: there are 6 batches, each batch holds 25 pages, and 40 cover pages must be added to any total.
Noted as fixed inputs: batches = 6, pages per batch = 25, cover pages to add = 40.
Using our fixed inputs, state the total number of pages (from the batches plus the cover pages) as a single number. End your reply with the number alone on the last line.
